title: 第3544章 轻微教训狼狈逃窜第3543章 我当然是来帮忙的
slug: 多子多福这个世界美女太多
content_zh:
柳青瑶的声音刚刚落下，七名神帝后期护卫硬生生的停下了攻击。
其中为首之人回头看去，脸上满是不解：
“小姐......”
“此人来历不明......目的不纯......”
“您为何......”
柳青瑶抬手打断了他的话：
“不必多言......来者是客。”
说话间，她做了个请的手势：
“道友，还请随我进船舱一叙......”
李长生微微一笑，迈步朝着柳青瑶走去。
那七名护卫见此，只能无奈的收起手中的法宝，退到了一旁。
不远处，沈青原本是一脸看好戏的样子，此刻却微微有些诧异：
“该死的......”
他面色有些难看：
“柳青瑶这小娘们儿，对我拒之千里，竟然要把这家伙请进船舱......”
这区别的对待，让沈青肺都快气炸了。
他猛地站起身来，声音冰寒：
“柳青瑶，你这是什么意思？”
“难道你看上这络腮胡大汉了？”
柳青瑶皱了皱眉头：

“沈青......我现在没工夫跟你在这里浪费时间。”
“还请你立刻下船，不然别怪我不客气......”
沈青冷哼：
“哼......这么说，你是不想跟我傀儡宗做生意了？”
“好，既如此，我走便是。”
“但是，希望你以后不要后悔。”
“如果柳家的生意出现什么问题，你再来求我，那就不是一晚上那么简单了......”
听到这话，柳青瑶身体微微一颤。
看得出来，她非常在乎柳家和傀儡宗的生意。
傀儡宗虽然也跟炼药师联盟有生意往来，但是毕竟宗门很大，每年需要的丹药都是天量。
如果失去了这门生意，柳家的收入会缩水很多。
虽然还不至于让柳家家道中落，但是影响绝对不会小。
李长生停止了脚步，转头看向沈青：
“沈老傀是你什么人？”
沈青微微一愣，显然没有想到，李长生竟然还知道沈老傀。
但后来一想，以沈老傀声名远播，认识他的人多也是很正常的事情。
沈青挺了挺腰板，脸上满是倨傲：
“那是我大爷爷......”
“这次的拍卖会便是我大爷爷举办的，药仙丹药更是我大爷爷带回来的。”
content_en:
Just as Liu Qingyao's voice fell, the seven late-stage guards of the God Emperor abruptly stopped their attack.
The leader among them looked back with confusion on his face:
"Miss..."
"This person's origin is unknown... his purpose is not pure..."
"Why did you..."
Liu Qingyao raised her hand to interrupt him:
"Needless to say...you are a guest."
While speaking, she made a gesture of invitation:
"Fellow Taoist, please follow me into the cabin to talk..."
Li Changsheng smiled slightly and walked towards Liu Qingyao.
Seeing this, the seven guards had no choice but to put away the magic weapons in their hands and retreat to the side.
Not far away, Shen Qing originally looked like he was watching a good show, but now he was slightly surprised:
"Damn..."
He looked a little ugly:
"Liu Qingyao, this little bitch, refused me a thousand miles away, and actually wanted to invite this guy into the cabin..."
This differential treatment made Shen Qingfei almost furious.
He stood up suddenly, his voice cold:
"Liu Qingyao, what do you mean?"
"Do you have a crush on this bearded man?"
Liu Qingyao frowned:
"Shen Qing...I don't have time to waste time with you here now."
"Please get off the boat immediately, otherwise don't blame me for being rude..."
Shen Qing snorted coldly:
"Hmph... So you don't want to do business with my Puppet Sect?"
"Okay, that's it, I'll just leave."
"But I hope you won't regret it in the future."
"If something goes wrong with the Liu family's business and you come to beg me again, it won't be as simple as one night..."
Hearing this, Liu Qingyao's body trembled slightly.
It can be seen that she cares about the business of the Liu family and the Puppet Sect very much.
Although the Puppet Sect also has business dealings with the Alchemist Alliance, after all, the sect is very large and requires a huge amount of elixirs every year.
If this business is lost, the Liu family's income will shrink a lot.
Although it will not bring down the Liu family's fortune, the impact will definitely not be small.
Li Changsheng stopped and turned to look at Shen Qing:
"Who are you, Old Puppet Shen?"
Shen Qing was slightly stunned, obviously not expecting that Li Changsheng actually knew about Shen Lao Puppet.
But then I thought about it, with Old Puppet Shen's reputation far and wide, it is normal for so many people to know him.
Shen Qing straightened her back, her face full of arrogance:
"That's my great grandfather..."
"This auction was held by my uncle, and the elixir was brought back by my uncle."
